title: What Retirement Housing Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of retirement housing: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Retirement housing: aging in place, downsizing, or senior communities. Key: single-level living, low maintenance, proximity to healthcare and people you love.

Why it matters: Most retirees prefer aging in place Single-level homes prevent fall risks

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Retirement Housing
summary: Start retirement housing this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Assess: stay, downsize, or relocate?
2. Audit home for aging-in-place (stairs, bathrooms)
3. Compare costs: stay vs move
4. Research 55+ communities if interested
5. Consider proximity to family/healthcare

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Common Retirement Housing Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with retirement housing — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Waiting for a crisis to decide → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Ignoring maintenance burden → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Moving far from support networks → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Overlooking HOA/fee costs → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.

title: Retirement Housing Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common retirement housing questions.
body:
Q: Age in place or move?
A: If the home works single-level and maintenance is manageable, staying is cheapest.

Q: When to decide?
A: Before health forces it - 60s, not 80s.

Q: Reverse mortgage?
A: Last resort; understand the costs fully.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
